canon: Faerus del Margen de la manada de Hashma: vieja, con el pelaje encanecido en el hocico, delgada pero con los hombros de quien ha cargado presas toda la vida; piel de hojas finas que susurra al moverse y pelaje denso en tonos de corteza y musgo. Se sienta en el Jakut Tusha, la gran plataforma en la horquilla del árbol más recio, y decide si un forastero pasa. Los Faerus no visten túnica ni sandalias.
fuentes: backend/src/scripts/worldCatalog.ts:4994-5003 (bio); docs/rpgtarkor/personajes/npcs.md:25; backend/src/services/berigLore.ts:243 (Faerus: piel de hojas, cuerpo fibroso, postura de dos a cuatro patas) y 270-274 (Faerus del Margen: pelaje denso de corteza y musgo); docs/rpgtarkor/lore-mundo/regiones/margen-silencioso.md:41-52 (Jakut Tusha); docs/canon-opencode/00-nucleo.md (sin túnica ni sandalias)

prompt.sujeto: A full-length view of a very old, lean female forest beast crouched on bent hind legs in the left third of the image, turned three-quarters to the right.
prompt.proporcion: Crouched, she stands about three of her own heads tall counting the crest, her shoulders two and a half heads wide and her long arms hanging to her knees.
prompt.ancla: a bear on its hind legs, only leaner, longer in the arm and more hunched
prompt.cuerpo: Her muzzle is short and broad, gone silver-grey with age, and her eyes glow a soft violet under a heavy brow. Dense fur in the ochre and olive tones of bark and moss covers her lean body, over the broad, worn shoulders of a lifelong hauler of prey.
rasgos: Thin, overlapping olive leaves with dry ochre edges grow from her skin along the crown, nape and forearms, rising into a ragged crest above her head.
Her only gear is a plaited fibre cord wrapped around her waist and wrists.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: Her knuckles are thick and calloused, and the leaves along her forearms are curled and faded at the tips.
prompt.pose: She squats on the edge of a wide wooden platform in the fork of a massive tree, her weight on her heels and one long hand on the planks, her head turned toward the viewer with a calm, patient stare.
prompt.entorno: Behind her rise huge black trunks wrapped in moss and dotted with pale blue-green glowing mushrooms; deeper back, platform huts joined by rope bridges hang among the branches, their small windows lit amber, in clear, perfectly still air.
prompt.luz: Dim green light filters through a closed canopy that hides the sky, with a few thin shafts falling from the upper left onto her shoulders and the planks.

momento:dia.luz: Dim green light filters through a closed canopy that hides the sky, with a few thin shafts falling from the upper left onto her shoulders and the planks.

momento:atardecer.luz: Deep green dusk settles under the closed canopy, a few last warm shafts slanting low from the left across the planks.

momento:noche.luz: Deep darkness fills the space under the canopy, broken only by the cold glow of the mushrooms and the warm amber of the hut windows rimming her silver muzzle.

propuestas: diseño de la imagen del juego (usuaria, 2026-10-26: «todo lo que hay ahora en las imágenes es lo que me gustaría igualar»); donde choca con el canon, va como propuesta de lore

del banner y fuera del canon: ojos de un violeta luminoso, cresta de hojas oliva con bordes ocres, setas luminosas azul verdosas en los troncos, chozas en plataformas unidas por puentes de cuerda con ventanas ámbar
del banner y fuera del canon: hocico corto y ancho (el canon solo dice que está encanecido); postura de oso erguido (el canon: de dos a cuatro patas)
choca con el banner, sigue al canon: sin los dos cuchillos de acero del banner (Hulki decide quién pasa, no lleva armas descritas) y vieja y delgada (el banner es la hembra genérica de la raza)
Jakut Tusha: el canon dice sala de piel y hueso con cráneos; el prompt solo pone la plataforma en la horquilla, sin cráneos ni sala
cordón de fibra trenzada en cintura y muñecas: del banner, sin fuente en el canon
medidas en cabezas (unas tres con la cresta, hombros de dos cabezas y media): diseño de imagen (banco r20-faerus-margen-hembra), no canon

capas.sujeto: A single very old, lean female forest beast, seen at full length from slightly below, three-quarters from the front, crouched on bent hind legs at the edge of a wide wooden platform in the fork of a massive tree, filling the image from the bottom edge to near the top on the left side.
capas.tamano: Crouched she is about three of her own heads tall counting the crest, her shoulders two and a half heads wide and her long arms hanging to her knees: lean and hunched, yet with the broad, worn shoulders of someone who has carried prey all her life.
capas.forma: She looks like a bear standing on its hind legs, only leaner, longer in the arm and more hunched. Her muzzle is short and broad under a heavy brow, and dense fur covers her whole body. Thin overlapping leaves like a willow's grow straight out of her skin along the crown, nape and forearms and rise into a ragged crest above her head; along the forearms they are curled at the tips. Her knuckles are thick and calloused.
capas.viste: Her only gear is a plaited fibre cord wrapped around her waist and wrists. She wears no tunic and no sandals.
capas.pose: She squats on her heels with one long hand on the planks, her head turned toward the viewer with a calm, patient stare.
capas.entorno: Behind her rise huge trunks wrapped in moss and dotted with small mushrooms; deeper back, small platform huts joined by rope bridges hang among the branches, each with a few small windows, in clear, perfectly still air. The closed canopy overhead hides the sky.
capas.color: Her muzzle has gone silver-grey with age and her eyes glow a soft violet. The dense fur is in the ochre and olive tones of bark and moss; the leaves are olive with dry ochre edges, faded at the tips. The trunks are black, wrapped in green moss, with pale blue-green glowing mushrooms; the planks are weathered brown, and the hut windows glow amber.
capas.paleta: ochre, olive and moss green with accents of pale blue-green glow
capas.corto: A single very old, lean female forest beast crouched on bent hind legs on a wooden platform, full length from slightly below, filling the left of the frame. Dim green light filters through the closed canopy, with thin shafts from the upper left on her shoulders. Thin overlapping willow leaves grow straight out of her skin along the crown, nape and forearms and rise into a ragged crest above her head. She looks like a bear standing on its hind legs, only leaner, with long arms hanging to her knees and a short broad muzzle. Fur ochre and olive, muzzle silver-grey, eyes soft violet.
capas.luz: Dim green light filters through the closed canopy, with a few thin shafts falling from the upper left onto her shoulders and the planks.
